property: The dedicated mail-transfer role is revised into SMTP's transport-independent sender/receiver and relay model; RFC 788 formally replaces RFC 772 and RFC 780.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 772 through RFC 788 and RFC 821 generations.

sources.supports: formal replacement of RFC 772/780 and SMTP transport/relay model
classic SMTP generation and transport-independent relay architecture

negative_claims: This edge does not collapse RFC 780, RFC 788 and RFC 821 into one revision event.
It does not describe message-format changes such as RFC 822.
It does not imply every deployed MTP implementation vanished on RFC publication day.
open_questions: Recover RFC 780 and build full command/state-machine diffs.
notes: Formal protocol-family replacement with a protocol name/architecture transition.
